title: P15.9-B5.2: /app/system/business-admin + /app/workforce/admin legacy admin parity
description: Legacy Business-tab parity on canonical APIs only (zero backend changes). /app/system/business-admin: create business (project_id verified via GET /api/projects, fail-closed when unavailable), inspect-by-id rendering biz.detail() bundle, global list labeled unfiltered. /app/workforce/admin bound to selected business: create org-agent (auto-contract), create work-item (never auto-opened), open/block/unblock/comment via pinned dialogs (open = HIGH-IMPACT trigger), routine create+enable/disable (mission_schedule), legacy objective labeled LEGACY compat vs vnext. Dialogs pin {op,biz,target,payload}, invalidate on business change, dup-submit guarded, ambiguous wording on transport/5xx, same-business-only selects (backend FAIL_CLOSED_*_SCOPE authoritative). apiAdmin wrappers (noAuthPrompt, AbortSignal). E2E workforce-admin.spec.ts covers the 19-item list. R1 fixes: (F1) SPA business switch synchronously wipes all business-dependent forms; submit() revalidates reports_to/assignee/objective_id against current selected-business lists, fail-closed when stale/unavailable. (F2) inspect clears stale detail synchronously, pinned LOADING row, verifies returned business_id === requested id (mismatch → error), late/out-of-order responses discarded. (F3) sect() validates envelopes before nested reads — null/primitive/non-array 200 → UNAVAILABLE MALFORMED, never an empty canonical list, pick() once; malformed primary agents read → fatal MALFORMED error. R2 fix: element-level validation on all B5.2 collection boundaries — rowsOk() rejects arrays containing null/primitive/identity-less rows as MALFORMED (never silently filtered into a fake complete list). agents (primary, requires agent_id+business_id) → fatal MALFORMED error; work_items/routines/objectives → per-section UNAVAILABLE; projects/businesses → MALFORMED blocks creation + unavailable global list; businessDetail validates agents/objectives/routines/board columns before render (invalid child → detailErr, no partial render). Proof: tsc+vite PASS; playwright workforce-admin 12/12.
